viewing_check: Lift the wig or look at the back of the head for the mould number and maker (AM 390, 370, 351 or other, or Heubach Koppelsdorf). Check head for hairlines or chips, eye mechanism, body paint, and whether the wig is original. A named mould in good order with original clothes could reach A$150+; an unmarked or restored head A$60-90.
